entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I'm calling about an order I placed a couple of months ago. I'd like to return a pair of cycling shoes.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Smith, and the order number is VF789012.
Thank you, Alex. I've pulled up your order. I see the VeloFit Pro cycling shoes, delivered about 79 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them?
They just don't fit right. No matter how I position the cleats or what socks I wear, I keep getting terrible blisters on any ride over an hour. They're just not working for me.
I'm sorry to hear that; getting blisters is definitely no fun and can ruin a ride. Let me just quickly check our return policy for you. One moment.
Alright, Alex, thank you for your patience. I can see here that you are well within our 90-day return window for standard items. I can go ahead and process that return for you for a full refund.

That's great news, I appreciate it. Now, since I had to deal with the discomfort and the hassle of calling in, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase? I still need new cycling shoes.

I understand your position. While I can't offer an additional discount code, I can definitely send you a pre-paid return label right away to make the refund process as smooth as possible. Would you like me to email that to the address on file?
Alright, fair enough. Yes, please send the label to my email. I'll get that shipped out this week.
Perfect. I've just sent it. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome, Alex. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
